pages.text: When held in the main or off hand, you can open a Trapped Chest without the chest firing off a redstone signal.$(br2)When used to upgrade a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radianttrove)Radiant Trove$(/l), the item type held by the trove becomes fixed. Even if the Trove's internal storage is reduced to 0 items, it reserves its storage for that type of item only.
Radiant Keys can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
